## Install

1. Download **{{DMG_NAME}}**, open it, and drag **TetherKitNext** to **Applications**.
2. Open **TetherKitNext** from Applications and click **Enable Background Component**; allow it once in *System Settings › General › Login Items & Extensions*.
3. Plug in your Android phone, turn on **USB tethering**, and click **Connect**.

Optional: *Settings › Command-line tool › Install Command* links `tetherkitnext-cli` into `/usr/local/bin`.

Universal build (**Apple Silicon + Intel**), macOS 14 Sonoma or later (bundled CLI supports macOS 13.3+).
Signed with **Developer ID** and **notarized by Apple**.

### Coming from TetherKit 0.2.0 (beta 1–3) or upstream TetherKit?

**TetherKitNext** installs alongside the old **TetherKit** app instead of replacing it. Remove the old app and its background helper first so both do not compete for your USB device: see the [upgrade steps](https://github.com/AA-EION/TetherKitNext#upgrading-from-tetherkit-020-betas).
